name: tool-bench
title: Tool Bench
purpose: Single-file host for small HTML tools that front CA_V3 flows: shared config injection, sandboxed runs, tool contracts naming the CA_V3 objects each tool depends on.

protocols.name: tool_config_injection
protocols.detail: window.TOOL_CONFIG and window.TOOL_META injected into inline tools before their own scripts

protocols.name: toolbench_config_message
protocols.detail: postMessage {type: toolbench:config, config, meta} to linked tools, targeted at the link's origin

protocols.name: tool_file_block
protocols.detail: each tool HTML carries its card fields and version in <script type=application/json id=toolbench-tool> (toolbench.tool/1, schema/toolbench.tool.schema.json); read on import, rewritten with a higher version on save

protocols.name: local_storage_only
protocols.detail: state lives in the browser's localStorage only; artifact storage from earlier builds is read once to migrate, never written

protocols.name: error_reporter
protocols.detail: inline tools get a reporter ahead of their scripts that posts {type: toolbench:error, kind, message, source, line, col, stack} to the bench; the bench logs it locally with its own errors and copies an entry out as a dev.bug.report payload

protocols.name: fetched_tool
protocols.detail: a registry url entry with run fetch is fetched without credentials, its X-CA-SHA256 header (when sent) checked against the body with crypto.subtle, and run inline with tool_config_injection and error_reporter; held in memory only

protocols.name: config_schema
protocols.detail: toolbench.tool/1 config_schema {namespace, fields[path,label,type,required,default,values,secret,help]}: the bench renders a Settings form, refuses a run on a missing, placeholder or invalid field, stores state.config[namespace] and injects it with defaults; secret values never leave the device

protocols.name: toolbench_config_set
protocols.detail: the running frame posts {type: toolbench:config:set, namespace, values} for the namespace its config_schema declares; the bench validates, stores, answers {type: toolbench:config:result, ok, errors|persisted, dropped} and reloads the tool

ca.why: Drafting Table tool speaks ca.draft/1 to the Drafting Engine

ca.kinds_note: snapshot of the declared kind prefixes (std kind via std change_broker kinds_known v9, 2026-10-23); used by the bench to flag kind_undeclared keys in tool contracts

governance.gate: merge only after the change's deploy card lands; for a release that card writes the release record to std external_links; a change that cuts no release is gated by acceptance

v4.note: D17: a V4 session is its principal; V4 commits name the increment doc (ca_v4/inc/<id>) and the tool session id, never C### or S####

releases.note: repo build, manifest, schema-2 storage with v1 migration, tool contracts, per-tool history, hardening
localStorage-only storage (schema 3); tool files carry their card fields and a version the bench bumps on save
each release is published as a GitHub Release with the built file attached; manifest declares distribution
Errors and fixes: error log panel (tool and bench errors, copy as bug report), Fixed in this version; CA-Bug trailer and ### Fixed checks (ca.repo/1 v3)
CA_V3 Viewer registered as a repo link tool (served by CA_V3 Viewer Host), fetched and run inline (run fetch, X-CA-SHA256 checked)
tool settings declared by the tool (config_schema): Settings form, run checks, tool-side save (toolbench:config:set), secrets kept on the device; CA_V3 Viewer declares its cav3 settings

V4 lane in the commit gate (Increment/Session trailers on v4|lab branches; governance.v4), CA_V4 pointer block in CLAUDE.md, .mcp.json for the CA_V4 Doc MCP. No page change.
